Gurugram launches campaign to clean garbage vulnerable points

Gurugram has launched the 'GVP-Free Campaign' with the objective of cleaning 21 garbage-vulnerable points within 10 days. This initiative is part of the 'Swachhata Hi Seva 2026' program.
